overview.tagline: Beta. Plex keyring schema — 182 data models covering Plex's complete read surface, generated from the vendor API dictionary

mainImage.alt: Plex Keyring Schema: Fuuz title card

description: Installs the complete Plex read surface as Fuuz data models — 182 models, 4,560 fields — generated from Plex's own API dictionary rather than hand-written.
This is the schema layer of the Plex keyring: somewhere to land every readable Plex object, with foreign keys resolved into real relations so applications traverse rather than join.

highlights.title: Plex's whole read surface
highlights.body: 182 data models and 4,560 fields, generated from Plex's own API dictionary.

highlights.title: Real relations
highlights.body: Foreign keys are resolved into relations, so apps traverse Plex data instead of joining it.

highlights.title: Safe load order
highlights.body: Models are layered by dependency (7 layers), so parent records always load before the records that reference them.

pricing.detail: Fuuz accelerators are no cost; you pay only for the Fuuz runtime.

support.sla: No service level agreement. Supported once implemented by a Fuuz services professional or an approved Fuuz partner.

security.notes: It reads from Plex into Fuuz; it doesn't write to Plex. Every row records where it came from.

prerequisites: A Fuuz tenant of its own for each Plex PCN: install once per PCN

steps.text: Set the PCN and source system in the tenant configuration. The read flows don't run until both are set.
Load the data in layer order (lowest loadLayer first), or run the plexKeyringLoadAll flow, which chains the layers.
